businessRules.statement: airport.icaoCode MUST match ^[A-Z]{4}$ and be unique. iataCode optional but unique when present.
Aircraft icao24 MUST match ^[0-9A-F]{6}$ (24-bit hex). tailNumber free-form but unique per registry.
OOOI events MUST be in order: scheduled → off-block → airborne → landed → in-block → completed. Out-of-order events return Conflict 409.
fatalities ≥ 1 OR hull-loss → accident; seriousInjuries ≥ 1 OR atc-incident → serious-incident; else incident. accident|serious-incident → authority audit post.
Incident records are append-only. Updates create a new incident with supersedes pointing at the original.
businessRules.enforcedBy: no UPDATE on incidents core fields
